title: Evidence
requiredNote: This category requires at least one supporting file (an invoice, a meter reading, a fuel receipt or fuel-card statement, a service or leak report, …) before it can be submitted.

refrigerantNote.intro: A refrigerant record needs at least one supporting file before it can be submitted. Accepted documents:
refrigerantNote.inventory: Equipment inventory list (a signed or stamped internal register)
refrigerantNote.serviceForm: Authorised service maintenance or periodic inspection form
refrigerantNote.nameplate: Equipment nameplate photo or technical specification page
refrigerantNote.invoice: Annual refill or maintenance invoice, if there is one

shareShortcut.button: Attach this document to the year's other gas records
shareShortcut.hint: If the same document also evidences this year's other gas records, attach it to all of them at once in the records table.

accepted: PDF, JPG, PNG, XLSX, CSV · max 10 MB
unsupportedType: {fileName}: unsupported type (PDF, JPG, PNG, XLSX, CSV only)
confirmOne: “{fileName}” will be attached to this record:
confirmMany: “{fileName}” will be attached, as one file, to these {count} records. Reviewers see every record it backs.
attachFailed: The file could not be attached.
detachedStillOne: Removed from this record — {fileName} still backs {count} other record.
detachedStillMany: Removed from this record — {fileName} still backs {count} other records.

held.hint: Choose the file now: it is uploaded when you save the draft or submit.
held.wait: Saving… choose the file again once the record is saved.

failed.title: Not uploaded. The record is saved as a draft.
